aesthetic.genre: playful tabletop game / family race game
aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a chaotic cartoon race — starting-line program meets sticker sheet

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: a racer character shrugging + invitation to draft
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: light, funny, never blaming ('That racer already finished — pick another!')
brand_voice_in_ui.tone: playful, teasing, celebratory — the rulebook's voice ('fast, dumb, and without a doubt... race a baby versus a banana')

composition.grouping_strategy: color-coded clusters (racers by token color; races by number pills)
composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + color weight (huge display type, saturated blocks)
composition.negative_space_role: yellow field frames the action; black panels anchor sections

imagery.illustration_style: flat cartoon, thick black outlines, saturated fills, wacky character-driven (Angela Kirkwood)
imagery.image_shape: rounded rectangles with black borders; standee silhouettes
imagery.pattern_usage: rainbow letter coloring for headings; repeating colored track-space grid
imagery.photo_treatment: product photos on seamless brand-yellow backdrop

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate and physical — buttons squash, dice shake, tokens hop
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: high — every race event gets a motion beat (hop, shake, burst)

visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element (the track / the draft board)
visual_language.ornamentation: decorative (stars, dice, speed lines, confetti, flowers)
visual_language.texture_usage: flat fills only; no gradients, no paper grain
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: one hero (track/logo) + distributed racer color pops
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous yellow field as breathing room; black panels as contrast blocks

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast: near-black warm text (#180A03) on yellow/off-white; white display type with black outline on red/black; never mid-tone text on a saturated color.

neutral.usage: Warm off-white #FCFBED for cards and panels on the yellow field; near-black warm browns #180A03/#370E06 for text and outlines; mid-browns for secondary text on light surfaces only.

primary.role: brand red — box cover, primary actions, race CTA

color.racer_palette_note: EXTENSION (not in base schema): 8 saturated token colors sampled from track spaces and podium blocks. Each of the 36 racers maps to one color from its standee/card art; cycle if exhausted. Never assign two racers in the same race the same token color when avoidable.

track_moods.mild_mile: measured — bright rainbow spaces (pink/yellow/green/blue/red-orange) on a black center band, white display type
track_moods.wild_wilds: UNMEASURED — the reverse side of the physical track has no reference in this DNA yet. Measure it from the real track before claiming Wild colors; do not invent them from Mild.

components.button_style: Chunky rounded rect (radius 14), 3px black border, hard 4px offset shadow, display face uppercase; primary = red bg, white text; press = translate 2px, shadow shrinks to 2px
components.card_style: Racer cards: off-white face, 3px black border, hard shadow, color-coded top band in the racer's token color, character art area, power text in body; collectible-card feel
components.component_notes: Section titles may use per-letter rainbow coloring (rulebook SETUP: S red, E green, T blue, U pink, P yellow). Race numbers use numbered pills with colored outlines (pink/orange/green/blue/purple cycle). Track spaces: flat saturated color, black grid, bold display numbers. One DNA per game; 36 racers each map to one of 8 racer token colors from their standee art.
components.input_style: Rounded 12px, 2px black border, off-white fill, display-face labels above
components.list_style: Draft list: rows with racer color chip left, name in display face, power in body; selected row lifts with shadow
components.modal_style: Centered sheet, white/off-white, 3px black border, 8px hard shadow, confetti burst on win modals
components.navigation_pattern: Top bar: yellow field, red logo lockup left, race progress (Race 1/4) as numbered pills with colored outlines (rulebook p.11 pattern)

elevation.depth_cues: hard offset shadows, overlapping standees/cards, black panels over yellow field

iconography.preferred_set: custom-drawn (dice, stars, trophies, speed lines); Lucide only as fallback, re-outlined to match
iconography.style: flat cartoon, thick black outline, filled saturated color — matching Angela Kirkwood's racer art

layout.alignment_tendency: centered stage with asymmetric playful clusters (racer cards, confetti) around it

motion.entrance_pattern: pop-in with overshoot + slight rotation (-2deg to 2deg)
motion.philosophy: playful bouncy — squash-and-stretch, never linear; dice roll = shake; race finish = confetti burst

shape.border_usage: bold 2-3px near-black outlines on cards, track spaces, buttons — outlines are a core brand element, not decoration
shape.divider_style: thick black rules (3px) or rainbow letter dividers; no hairlines

spacing.section_rhythm: Large, even gaps — 32px/48px between sections; cards breathe; touch targets minimum 48px (ages 6+).

font_families.heading: Titan One / Bungee (closest Google Fonts to the hand-drawn extra-bold display face — the actual box face is custom; verify against reference)
font_families.mono: not used — race numbers and scores always use the display face

typography.font_style_notes: Display face: extra-bold, slightly condensed, hand-drawn wobble, all-caps; white fill with 2-3px black outline and hard offset shadow on red/black. Body: rounded sans, generous line-height, sentence case. Numbers always display face, never body.

meta.description: Visual identity of the 2025 CMYK edition of Magical Athlete (design Takashi Ishida, updated design Richard Garfield, art Angela Kirkwood), extracted from official product photography and the rulebook layout. One DNA per game; every web-app screen derives from this file.
meta.name: Magical Athlete — Design DNA v1
source_references: Rulebook PDF (bghub.org mirror), pages 10-11 (components + setup layout)

3d_elements.description: No 3D — the game is flat illustration; depth comes from hard shadows and overlap

background_effects.description: Flat saturated yellow field; no animated background except celebration confetti (see particle_systems)

canvas_drawings.description: Speed-line streaks behind moving racer tokens (box-art motion lines)

params.color_scheme: white + racer color on black track band

visual_effects.composite_notes: Two moods: Mild Mile is the measured reference (bright rainbow on black). Wild Wilds (reverse side) is NOT yet measured — its palette must be extracted from the physical track's reverse before the DNA claims it; do not invent Wild colors from Mild. Product photos are shot on seamless brand-yellow; the rulebook's own layout uses black panels with rainbow headings — both surfaces belong in the DNA (yellow = lobby/draft chrome, black = race-stage panels). DNA extracts the design language, not the illustrations: the 36 racer artworks remain real assets to be placed as images, never redrawn by the model. Verify any generated screen with verify.mjs against magical-athlete.dna.json.

cursor_effects.description: Standard cursor; touch-first game (ages 6+, big targets)

image_effects.description: Racer cards tilt slightly toward the pointer (max 6deg) with shadow shift; standees hop on selection

particle_systems.description: Multi-color confetti burst on race finish / trophy award, matching the podium photo (red/blue/pink/white rectangles + dots)

scroll_morphing.description: Not applicable — app screens, not a scrolling page

shader_effects.description: No shaders; flat fills by design

svg_animations.description: Dice face SVGs, star bursts and trophy icons with subtle draw/wiggle loops

text_effects.description: Section headings may color each letter from the rainbow cycle (rulebook SETUP treatment); race titles pop in letter-by-letter with stagger

params.effect_style: rainbow fill per letter, black outline retained
